requirements.text: Given valid criteria, clicking Generate produces up to `quantity` unique names satisfying 100% of hard constraints (length, syllables, starts-with, ends-with, must-include, must-not-include).
requirements.notes: Covered by __tests__/engine.test.ts assertions on quantity/length/starts/mustInclude/mustNotInclude.

requirements.text: Same seed + same criteria MUST produce byte-identical result list (determinism).
requirements.notes: Covered by 'is deterministic for same seed + criteria' test.

requirements.text: Each result shows score, components, phonetic respelling, syllable count, tags, and at least one rationale line.
requirements.notes: Covered by NameCard component tests + engine rationale assertions.

requirements.text: All 8 mandatory UI states render honestly: idle, validating, loading, success, empty, degraded_offline, recoverable_error, terminal_error.
requirements.notes: State machine lives in app/page.tsx `GenState`; empty/degraded/error paths implemented in components and error.tsx/global-error.tsx.

requirements.text: Mobile-first layout: thumb-zone bottom action bar, bottom-sheet criteria, collapsible sections, safe-area aware, 48px/40px/44px touch targets.
requirements.notes: Covered by Sheet + CriteriaForm collapsible section tests.

requirements.text: CSV export MUST neutralize DDE/formula injection (= + - @ \t \r % | ' ").
requirements.notes: lib/safe-csv.ts; tested via sanitizeCsvCell + generateSafeCsv assertions.

requirements.text: Local persistence (IndexedDB → localStorage → in-memory fallback) with corruption-safe Zod parse on load.
requirements.notes: lib/storage.ts safeGet/safeSet, loadHistory validates per-record.

requirements.text: The accepted core outcome (brief → scored name list) works end-to-end on the declared browser matrix (production build).
requirements.notes: HTTP-level production-build smoke passed via curl; browser-engine smoke is capability-blocked (no browser in sandbox) — waiver + compensating control required for `release-ready`.

requirements.text: The accepted core outcome is verified end-to-end in a real browser runner.
requirements.notes: Blocked: no Playwright/Cypress binary in sandbox.

requirements.text: Accessibility minimum bar: visible focus, keyboard-operable, ≥24×24 pointer targets (we claim 44/40/48), reflow at 320 CSS px / 400% zoom, prefers-reduced-motion.
requirements.notes: Design satisfies the bar (globals.css + Dialog/Sheet focus traps + reduced-motion media query). Automated axe scan is blocked (no browser); keyboard and screen-reader passes blocked by lack of browser/AT in sandbox. Compensating control: manual static review of focus-trap + aria + reduced-motion CSS.

requirements.text: Security headers set (X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Content-Security-Policy, COOP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS) and X-Powered-By removed on all routes.
requirements.notes: Verified via curl -I against production build; evidence in artifacts/evidence/smoke-headers.log.

requirements.text: No secrets in source, client bundle, or source maps.
requirements.notes: Scan evidence in artifacts/evidence/sec-client-bundle.log; .env.example contains only NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.

requirements.text: CSRF review for authenticated state-changing endpoints (U-03).
requirements.notes: Not-applicable: data_identity=local-only; no authenticated endpoints; no state-changing server routes beyond GET /api/health.

requirements.text: Rate limiting / abuse controls on public auth/write/payment endpoints (U-03).
requirements.notes: Not-applicable: no public auth/write/payment endpoints; GET /api/health is public read-only and returns a static JSON object with no side effects.

requirements.text: Dependency advisory scan (POL-ADVISORY-028) run and recorded; a failing/unavailable scanner is `blocked`, never silently clean.
requirements.notes: `npm audit` run and recorded. Zero critical after bumping next 15.5.23 → 15.5.27. Remaining 12 (3 moderate, 9 high) are all transitive build/dev deps (postcss, sharp, brace-expansion, micromatch, braces, js-yaml, vitest/@vitest/mocker, eslint-plugin-next/fast-glob) with no runtime server surface. Documented in artifacts/security.json.

requirements.text: Visual matrix (320/768/1280 CSS px viewports; 200%/400% zoom; light/dark; reduced motion).
requirements.notes: Blocked: no headless browser in sandbox to capture screenshots. Compensating control: mobile-first CSS reviewed; globals.css honors prefers-color-scheme + prefers-reduced-motion.

requirements.text: Cold page load + primary-flow timing measured on the declared target.
requirements.notes: Blocked: no Lighthouse/browser available. HTTP curl against production build showed 32,795-byte home response in ~3ms server-side (artifacts/evidence/smoke-home.log); not a real-browser cold-load number.
